title: Story premise ENT107: The Time Machine With a Receipt
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: Every retry forgets why we tried. Takeaway/theme: A retry helps only if something learned survives it.
description: An inventor wants to recover a dropped biscuit by rewinding ten seconds, but each rewind also undoes the machine’s own setup. They write the lesson on an external fantasy receipt that persists across resets, then stop rewinding and place a plate beneath the biscuit’s next wobble.
